channel.title: Kinexus Insights
channel.description: Straight talk for factory owners: trade windows, tariff volatility, buyer audits, quality proof, and cash discipline.

item.title: The UK just dropped its tariff wall on your components
item.description: On 15 July 2026 the India–UK CETA takes UK duties on engineering and auto components to zero. Here's how to make the saving land with you, not a rival.

item.title: Zero duty into the UK: Ludhiana's once-in-a-generation window
item.description: From 15 July 2026, UK duties of up to 12% on Indian knitwear vanish under CETA. The differentiator shifts from price to documented, auditable reliability.

item.title: Pharma's US tariff rollercoaster — and what Baddi should actually do about it
item.description: US duty on Indian pharma has swung from 50% to 10% in a year. Stop building strategy on a quarterly number and build the operations every market rewards.

item.title: How do you quote exports when tariffs change every quarter?
item.description: You can't control trade policy. You can control how fast you re-price accurately when it moves — and that's an operations skill, not a trade one.

item.title: The buyer's first question isn't price anymore. It's proof.
item.description: Global apparel buyers now open with compliance and traceability, then move to price. Proof compounds — price gets you compared, proof gets you kept.

item.title: Your next audit will be won or lost in your records, not your lab
item.description: Most failed pharma inspections aren't about bad medicine — they're about bad records of good medicine. Close the gap at the source, permanently.
